name: horizon-precert
description: Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey commercial prior-authorization packet for a hospital-outpatient (POS 22) knee arthroscopy. The 'Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey' letterhead routes the bundle to the 'horizon' payer bucket (spec-v52 §4.5.20) and engages the Horizon commercial overlay. The packet cites the applicable Medical Policy and includes clinical context, while transport, member-specific authorization-list, and site-of-care workflow remain external. The hospital setting does not by itself assert that site-of-care review applies. Every conditional Horizon service-review rule therefore self-gates off.

Clinical note
Chief complaint: left knee pain with locking and catching.
History of present illness: four months of mechanical symptoms despite activity modification.
Physical exam: positive McMurray on the left; joint-line tenderness medially.
Assessment and plan: left medial meniscus tear; recommend arthroscopic partial meniscectomy.
Medical necessity: imaging confirms a displaced medial meniscus tear.
Note date: 2026-06-10
Signed: Ortho Sports MD, 2026-06-10
